original_benchmark.notes: Released Video-Index test set (Video-Index/Video-Index, items/test.jsonl). The paper's agentic results come from one CLI-agent session per question on the video file (Claude Code 2.1.278 with tools Bash and Read, maximum reasoning effort, 1,800 s per question; Codex and Gemini CLI runs as well). 102 of the 840 released questions were replaced after those runs.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity pending; agents, models, subset and number of runs to be agreed with the Harbor team. An optional blind protocol (--protocol blind, 3,360 tasks) is not part of the registered dataset.
